- [IRET.28.6.1.2] `ds_oa_reserve` ensures capacity for at least `n` live
  entries without a later grow: it sets `cap` to the smallest power of two
  with `n ≤ cap · load_pct / 100`, rehashing extant entries. It is the RT
  presize step before entering `locked` mode. On allocation failure it
  returns `DS_ERR_OOM` and leaves the table unchanged.
